Title: 2nd Tradition, Rotschrek and Elysium type cards.

Messages.Author: S. Dembo
Messages.Body:
Re 2nd Tradition: Umm... you have to remember that Wake with evening
freshness doesNOT untap the vampire, he can attempt to block and play
reaction cards AS IF untapped, but he does not untap... The only card
that actually lets you untap is Rat's Warning, making the 2nd tradition
only usable by animalism folks then... <>shakes head<> It makes sense
that it untaps the vampire, that's what makes it cool...

Rotschrek: I know this has been ruled a thousand times, but I'm in charge
of a forum called Strategy Card Games on the ISCAbbs and there's a few
people who want me to actually post the ruling. So, Tom, could you humor
them and simply put up a message saying, YES Rotschrek is in a sense a
big misprint and its meant to be played on a vampire attempting to deal
out aggrevated damage? Thanks! Much appreciated...

Elysium, Police Department and Mob Connections: Well, real quick question
here... Can these cards be used to affect combats in which your vampires
aren't even in? As in can I use Elysium to end a combat between my prey
and his prey? Or can I use Mob Connections to force a press between two
other Methuselahs?
Thanks in advance!

Oh yeah, cards I'm still looking for...
Kine Dominance
Monocle of Clarity
Renegade Garou
Golconda
Madness Network
Sudden Reversal
2nd Tradition
Eagle's Sight

Mail me if you want to work soemthing out!
Steve
